name: Shadow-Cursed Pilgrim
backstory: Shadow-Cursed Pilgrims are a type of undead creature which may be found in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two. They are pilgrims who have been taken by the shadow curse and turned into mindless creatures.
